land.text: Svaneti, 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti' from 1463 (infobox), the Dadeshkeliani holding Upper Svaneti by the 1720s

predecessors.note: The infobox also lists the Kingdom of Georgia (the duchy of Svaneti 1008-1490) as predecessor. Cliopatria starts the principality in 1721; the infobox says 1463, the text the 1460s.

land.text: the principality 'abolished and converted into a district' in 1858

successors.note: Vassal of the Russian Empire 1833-1857 (infobox); the Svan clans outside the principality (Free Svaneti) were ruled separately until 1876 (Free Svaneti page).

capitals.name: Upper Svaneti (no capital named by the source)
capitals.note: The infobox gives 'Capital: Not specified'; the point is the centroid of the Cliopatria shape, not a town.

keyframe_review.note: 2,791 km2. The page gives no area; the Svaneti page gives 5,776.4 km2 for the whole historical region, a ratio of 0.48. The difference is the land outside the principality: Lower Svaneti, 'gradually subjugated by the Dadiani princes of Mingrelia' (undated), and Free Svaneti, a separate clan confederation. The shape is therefore Upper Svaneti under the Dadeshkeliani, who 'by the 1720s' had won the struggle with the Richgviani for Upper Svaneti.

2,508 km2, 283 km2 less than the 1721 shape. None of the five pages opened records a change of Svan territory in 1775; the Russian Empire becomes a Cliopatria neighbour that year, so the trim is read as cartographic and the shape stands.

2,389 km2. The Kingdom of Imereti, which the Svaneti infobox names as suzerain ('subject of Kingdom of Imereti, 1463-1833'), was annexed by Russia on 20 February 1810 (Imereti infobox 'Russian Annexation: 20 February 1810'; vassal of Russia from 25 April 1804). The Imereti page does not mention Svaneti, so no Svan border move is documented; the shape stands. The ledger closes the Imeretian subjection at the annexation of 1810 (vassal_end, February 1810) although the Svaneti infobox runs it to 1833; from 1810 to November 1833 no page names a suzerain.

2,365 km2. The page puts the split of the principality into two branches by a Dadeshkeliani blood feud in the 1820s (no year) and both branches' 'nominal Russian suzerainty' in 1833; the shape is the combined principality, which is how the page treats it until 1857.

correction.text: The principality as a Russian vassal: Cliopatria's last shape (1830-1833) carried to the abolition of 1858. Status in this period: vassal of the Russian Empire from 26 November 1833 to 1857 (vassal_start/vassal_end in the ledger), then subdued by force and abolished in 1858 (contest 1857-1858).

keyframe_review.note: New keyframe: Cliopatria ends the principality in 1833, but the page has it a Russian vassal from 1833 to 1857 ('vassal of Russian Empire: 1833-1857'; protectorate treaty of 26 November 1833 on the Svaneti page) and 'abolished and converted into a district' in 1858. Status of the whole keyframe: vassal until 1857, contested 1857-1858. The page gives no boundary for these years.

region.text: Upper Svaneti, where 'by the 1720s' the Dadeshkeliani clan had won the struggle with the Richgviani

ledger.note: 1721: Cliopatria's first shape of the Dadeshkeliani principality of Upper Svaneti. The year is Cliopatria's; the page says only 'by the 1720s' for the Dadeshkeliani victory, and dates the principality itself to the 1460s (infobox 'Established 1463', the Gelovani 'virtually independent' as Georgia split). Re-opened 2026-11-01: the Svaneti page does not date the Dadeshkeliani victory either (it says only that fighting broke out for the province after the 1460s disintegration of Georgia), so the confidence stays 1.

region.text: Upper Svaneti, 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti' (infobox)

ledger.note: 1721: the Dadeshkeliani principality, as the infobox has it, is 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti' (infobox '1463-1833'). The infobox dates the subjection from 1463; the dossier's life starts in 1721 (Cliopatria's first shape), so the vassal relation is opened here. The page describes no tribute, treaty or act of homage; status is the infobox's.

1810, February: the Kingdom of Imereti ceases when Russia annexes it ('Russian Annexation: 20 February 1810'; 'deposed entirely in 1810'), so it can no longer be suzerain. The Svaneti infobox runs the Imeretian subjection to 1833, which contradicts the Imereti page; I take 1810 because a state that no longer exists cannot hold a vassal, and no page names another suzerain for 1810-1833 (the Imereti page does not mention Svaneti at all). The year is the page's; the link between annexation and the end of Svan subjection is my reading, hence confidence 2.

region.text: Svaneti: 'Prince Tsioq' Dadeshkeliani of Svanetia signed a treaty of protectorate with the Russian Empire on November 26, 1833'

ledger.note: 1833, 26 November: Prince Tsioq' Dadeshkeliani signs a treaty of protectorate with the Russian Empire (Svaneti page); the principality page has 'both branches accepted nominal Russian suzerainty in 1833' and the infobox 'vassal of Russian Empire: 1833-1857'. Cliopatria's shape ends in 1833, so the 1830 shape is carried.

1857: the Russian vassalage ends where the infobox puts it ('vassal of Russian Empire: 1833-1857'), the year Baryatinsky 'ordered Svaneti to be subdued by armed force' (contest_start below). The page does not say that the order itself ended the protectorate, and the principality is formally abolished only in 1858, so the year is the infobox's and the cause my reading.

region.text: Svaneti, which Baryatinsky 'ordered ... to be subdued by armed force'

ledger.note: 1857: Prince Baryatinsky orders Svaneti subdued by armed force after the Dadeshkeliani feud. The page dates the order, not any battle; Prince Constantine Dadeshkeliani was later court-martialled and shot after killing a Russian administrator.
1858: the fighting ends with the abolition of the principality; the infobox gives the end as 1857-1858.

region.text: the principality 'abolished and converted into a district'

ledger.note: 1858: Russia abolishes the Principality of Svaneti and makes it a district. The infobox gives the successor as the Russian Empire.

wars.name: Russian subjugation of Svaneti
wars.outcome: Baryatinsky 'ordered Svaneti to be subdued by armed force' (1857); the principality was 'abolished and converted into a district' in 1858.
wars.note: Free Svaneti, the clans outside the principality, held out to 1876 per the Free Svaneti page ('The last vestiges of the Svan self-rule was brought to an end by the Russian military in 1876'), while the same page also says 'subjected to the Russian Empire in 1853'.

certainty.note: Mountain valleys on both sides of the Greater Caucasus with no treaty or survey line; the 1833 protectorate fixed no boundary.

sources.title: Principality of Svaneti
sources.note: Identity, infobox (1463, 1857-1858, subject of Imereti 1463-1833, Russian vassal 1833-1857), the 1720s, 1820s feud, 1833 suzerainty, 1857 force, 1858 abolition. No area.

sources.title: Svaneti
sources.note: Region area 5,776.4 km2; 'treaty of protectorate with the Russian Empire on November 26, 1833' signed by Prince Tsioq' Dadeshkeliani; autonomy 'until 1857'.

sources.title: Kingdom of Imereti
sources.note: Svaneti's suzerain: vassal of Russia 25 April 1804, annexed 20 February 1810; no mention of Svaneti.

sources.title: Principality of Mingrelia
sources.note: Looked for Dadiani Svaneti: the page does not mention Svaneti; Mingrelia a Russian vassal 1803-1867.

sources.title: Free Svaneti
sources.note: Free Svaneti emerged in the 15th century, sought Russian protection from the early 1830s, 'last vestiges ... brought to an end ... in 1876'.

notes:
Start and end: Cliopatria 1721..1833; the page's infobox says 1463..1857-58. The dossier takes 1721 (Cliopatria's first Dadeshkeliani shape; the page says only 'by the 1720s') and 1858 (the page's abolition). The earlier phase 1463-1720 (Gelovani rule, the Richgviani rivalry, formal subjection to Imereti) is not drawn: no page gives its extent. A gap-filler could add it if the map should show Svaneti before 1721.
Suzerainty (revised 2026-11-01 after review): the vassal events are in this ledger as well as in the suzerains' dossiers, because the mirror rule needs both. vassal_start 1721 / vassal_end February 1810 with kingdom-of-imereti (infobox: 'subject of Kingdom of Imereti, 1463-1833'; the Imereti page has the kingdom annexed on 20 February 1810, so I end the subjection there, not in 1833 as the infobox does; the 1810-1833 interval has no named suzerain on any page). vassal_start 26 November 1833 / vassal_end 1857 with russian-empire (Svaneti page: treaty of protectorate; infobox: vassal 1833-1857). The 1857 end is the infobox's; the principality is abolished in 1858. The dossiers kingdom-of-imereti and russian-empire (other batches) carry no Svaneti vassal events yet: route to eu-19 and eu-17.
Undated: Lower Svaneti ('Dadiani Svaneti') subjugated by the Dadiani princes of Mingrelia (loss to principality-of-mingrelia, no year); the 1820s split into two Dadeshkeliani branches; Free Svaneti's 1840 acceptance of Russian suzerainty and its end (1853 versus 1876 on the Free Svaneti page, 1858-59 elsewhere). The Mingrelia page does not mention Svaneti at all.
No capital: the infobox says 'Not specified'; the capital dot sits at the shape centroid. No rulers list: the page gives rulers without dates.
